'''Teth''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Teth system/Legends|Teth system]] in the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by six [[Planet/Legends|planets]].
